results.text: Telmisartan potentiates the ITE-induced aryl hydrocarbon receptor activity in human liver cell line. Telmisartan is an angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) approved by the Food and Drug Administration of the US for the treatment of hypertension. It possesses unique pharmacologic properties, including the longest half-life among all ARBs; this leads to a 24-h sustained reduction of blood pressure. Population Pharmacokinetics of Telmisartan in Healthy Subjects and Hypertensive Patients. Telmisartan exhibits significant pharmacokinetic (PK) variability, but it remains unclear whether its PK profile is altered in hypertensive patients. This study aimed to characterize telmisartan PKs by conducting a meta-analysis and developing a pooled population PK model based on data from healthy subjects and hypertensive patients.
